Premium art-directed editorial lighting, believable contact shadows, 70mm product photography lens, three-quarter camera at 25 degrees above table, accurate parallel edges, controlled specular highlights, rich but realistic color, sharp manufacturing detail. No flowers, no random props, no imitation famous brand, no visible typography, no floating lid, no hinges on the drawer, no impossible geometry, no excessive gold.
